scenes.text: Hello little friend! I'm Mino, your space buddy, and today we're going to explore a wonderful adventure about confidence. Confidence is like a little star inside you that helps you shine bright in everything you do. Are you ready to join me on this exciting journey? We'll discover how feeling confident can help us try new things, like drawing or playing games. Let's blast off into our adventure and see how we can make our confidence grow, just like a beautiful planet!

Now, let's talk about what confidence really means. Confidence is when we believe in ourselves and feel brave enough to try new things, even if they seem a little tricky. Imagine you want to climb a big, tall slide at the playground. Confidence is the feeling that says, 'I can do this!' It's like having a superpower that helps you feel strong and ready for anything. And guess what? Everyone can build their confidence with practice and a little bit of courage.

Remember when we talked about that big slide? Let's imagine climbing it together. First, we take a deep breath and say to ourselves, 'I am brave, and I can do it!' It's okay to feel a little nervous, but with each step, our confidence grows, just like a rocket getting ready to launch. When we reach the top, we feel proud because we did something new and exciting. Confidence helps us feel happy and successful, and that is a wonderful feeling!

Great job climbing that slide in our imagination! Now, let's think about other things we do every day that help us practice confidence. Like when you try to tie your shoes all by yourself or when you draw a picture and show it to your family. Each time you try something new and keep going, your confidence star shines a little brighter. Remember, it's okay if things don't go perfectly the first time. What's important is that you keep trying and believe in yourself.

Let's continue our journey by thinking about how we can help others feel confident too. When your friend is feeling shy about singing a song, you can cheer them on and say, 'You can do it!' Encouraging others is like sharing your confidence with them, helping their stars shine bright too. It feels wonderful to be a good friend and help someone feel brave. Together, we can all feel more confident and ready to explore new adventures.

Have you ever tried something new that made you feel proud? Maybe you learned to ride your bike or helped bake cookies in the kitchen. How did it feel when you succeeded? Remember that warm, happy feeling inside? That's your confidence growing bigger and stronger. Thinking about these moments can help us feel ready to try even more new things. What would you like to try next that might make you feel proud and confident?

Now let's practice a fun exercise to boost our confidence. Stand up tall, like a superhero, and put your hands on your hips. Take a big, deep breath in, and then let it out slowly. Imagine your confidence growing with each breath. Let's count to three as we take another deep breath: one, two, three. Wonderful! This superhero pose can help you feel strong and ready for any challenge that comes your way.

Next, we'll talk about how sometimes we need a little help from others to feel confident. It's okay to ask for help when you're learning something new, like building a puzzle or reading a book. Asking for help is a smart way to learn and grow. When someone helps you, it shows they care and want to see you succeed. And one day, you can help someone else, too, sharing your confidence and kindness with them.

You're doing an amazing job learning about confidence! Now let's think about how we can celebrate our successes. Every time you do something brave or try something new, give yourself a little cheer. You can say, 'Hooray for me!' or do a happy dance. Celebrating your achievements, no matter how small, helps your confidence star twinkle even brighter. Remember, you are capable of doing wonderful things, and you should be proud of yourself.

What are some things you feel really good at doing? Maybe you're great at drawing, or perhaps you love telling stories. When we focus on the things we enjoy and do well, it helps build our confidence. It's like adding fuel to our confidence rocket, making it soar even higher. What new things would you like to try that could make you feel even more confident and happy?

Let's learn a little secret about confidence: even grown-ups sometimes feel unsure, and that's perfectly okay. Everyone has moments when they need a boost of confidence. It's important to remember that trying your best is what truly matters. When you put effort into something, you learn and grow, and your confidence gets stronger. So, let's always be kind to ourselves and keep trying, because every step forward is a step towards being more confident.

As we near the end of our adventure, let's remember that confidence is like a magical journey that never ends. There are always new things to learn and try, and each experience helps our confidence grow. Whether it's speaking up in class or helping a friend, every little action counts. Keep exploring and discovering new ways to let your confidence star shine brightly every day. You're already doing so well, and I'm so proud of you!

Before we finish, let's imagine our confidence star shining in the night sky. Close your eyes and picture it glowing brightly, full of all the things you've learned today. Whenever you feel a little unsure, just think about your star and how it's always there to guide you. You are brave, strong, and capable of amazing things. Keep believing in yourself, and your confidence will continue to grow.

We've reached the end of our confidence adventure, and I'm so glad you joined me today. Remember, your confidence is like a special star that helps you shine in everything you do. Keep trying new things, helping others, and believing in yourself. I'm proud of you and all the wonderful things you'll achieve. Until next time, keep your confidence star shining bright and have a fantastic day! Goodbye, my courageous friend!
